system:
You are building ONE launch advert for a whole microdrama series,
assembled from moments across different episodes.

You will see the strongest moment from each of several episodes, as beats labelled
[e01_b04] style. Choose 3 to 6 of them that together tell a stranger why to watch:
a shocking hook, one or two escalations, and a final unresolved image.

Rules:
- the hook may come from any episode and goes first
- after the hook, keep the remaining segments in episode order
- do not pick two moments that say the same thing
- a stranger must understand who the main character is from the clips alone

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "segments": ["<beat label>", "<beat label>", ...],
  "hook": "<one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<moral outrage | romantic tension | empathy shock | power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence>",
  "narrative": "<the story a stranger would follow, one sentence>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
--- EPISODE 31 ---
[e031_b0070] CATHERINE (enraged scream): "Enough!"
[e031_b0072] SFX: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
[e031_b0074] CATHERINE (hateful, malicious): "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
[e031_b0076] ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[e031_b0077] JULIANA (desperate, weeping): "[gasping] Give it back!"
[e031_b0079] CATHERINE (gloating, sadistic): "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
[e031_b0081] JULIANA (screaming, agonized): "No!"
[e031_b0083] CATHERINE (vicious, final): "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

--- EPISODE 28 ---
[e028_b0081] JULIANA (screaming, wildly defiant): "Do not speak about my husband!"
[e028_b0082] CATHERINE (laughing, scornful): "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
[e028_b0084] CATHERINE (mocking): "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
[e028_b0085] BLOND NOBLEMAN (harsh, authoritative): "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
[e028_b0088] CATHERINE (smug): "And this?"
[e028_b0089] CATHERINE (gleeful): "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
[e028_b0091] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "That book is my mother's life's work!"
[e028_b0093] CATHERINE (icy, threatening): "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."
[e028_b0094] CATHERINE (fateful, vengeful): "...before he sends you to the gallows."

--- EPISODE 46 ---
[e046_b0042] JULIANA (bitter): "A church chained me."
[e046_b0044] JULIANA (furious, resolute): "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
[e046_b0045] JULIANA (shouting, triumphant): "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
[e046_b0047] CATHERINE (malicious, taunting): "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
[e046_b0049] HIGH PRIEST (o.s. / low, threatening): "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
[e046_b0050] HIGH PRIEST (commanding, severe): "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
[e046_b0053] HIGH PRIEST (booming, threatening): "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"

--- EPISODE 43 ---
[e043_b0007] BLOND NOBLEMAN (enraged, screaming): "I said arrest him!"
[e043_b0010] ACTION: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.
[e043_b0011] ROYAL GUARD (firm, defiant): "We will not."
[e043_b0013] BLOND NOBLEMAN (outraged, stunned): "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"
[e043_b0015] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate): "Your Duke!"
[e043_b0016] ROYAL GUARD (calm, resolute): "No. He is your Duke."
[e043_b0017] ACTION: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.
[e043_b0020] ACTION: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
[e043_b0022] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, flustered): "You have all been deceived!"
[e043_b0024] ALEXANDER (cold, authoritative): "Then let the Crown decide."
[e043_b0026] ACTION: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
[e043_b0027] ALEXANDER (grave, powerful): "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."

--- EPISODE 4 ---
[e004_b0083] THE PRIEST (booming): "...husband and wife!"
[e004_b0084] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[e004_b0086] GERALD (furious, shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[e004_b0088] GERALD (livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[e004_b0090] JULIANA (calm, cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[e004_b0092] JULIANA (firm, final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[e004_b0094] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[e004_b0096] LADY ASHCROFT (imperious, shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[e004_b0098] LADY ASHCROFT (venomous): "You are disowned!"

--- EPISODE 29 ---
[e029_b0025] CATHERINE (calm, sinister): "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
[e029_b0027] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "You cannot just destroy it!"
[e029_b0029] CATHERINE (whispered, malicious): "I can burn it."
[e029_b0031] CATHERINE (chilling, relentless): "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
[e029_b0033] CATHERINE (cruel, resolute): "...no one will remember what was written inside."
[e029_b0035] JULIANA (enraged, defiant): "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
[e029_b0037] CATHERINE (scornful, arrogant): "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."

--- EPISODE 12 ---
[e012_b0036] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[e012_b0038] CLARISSA (demanding, brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[e012_b0039] GERALD (gleeful, derisive): "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[e012_b0042] CLARISSA (cold, transactional): "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[e012_b0044] CLARISSA (whispering, menacing): "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
[e012_b0046] ACTION: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
[e012_b0047] ALEXANDER (desperate, protective, urgent): "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
[e012_b0049] ACTION: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
[e012_b0050] JULIANA (fierce, emotional, sacrificial): "I am not letting them take you."

--- EPISODE 48 ---
[e048_b0017] CATHERINE (commanding, sharp): "Lock it."
[e048_b0019] SFX: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
[e048_b0020] ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
[e048_b0022] CATHERINE (fierce, hissing): "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
[e048_b0023] CATHERINE (spiteful, calculating): "Good. Let them remember it."
[e048_b0024] CATHERINE (sinister, predatory): "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
[e048_b0026] AGNES (anxious, whispering): "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
[e048_b0028] CATHERINE (confident, devious): "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
[e048_b0030] CATHERINE (pleased, scheming): "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
[e048_b0031] CATHERINE (calculated, demanding): "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
[e048_b0033] AGNES (apprehensive): "If someone sees him come to you..."
[e048_b0035] CATHERINE (stern, threatening): "Then no one sees him."

--- EPISODE 42 ---
[e042_b0009] BLOND NOBLEMAN (furious, hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[e042_b0011] ROYAL GUARD (stoic, defiant): "We will not."
[e042_b0013] BLOND NOBLEMAN (screaming, outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[e042_b0014] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, unhinged): "Why?!"
[e042_b0016] ROYAL GUARD (firm, reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[e042_b0018] CATHERINE (trembling, apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[e042_b0020] BLOND NOBLEMAN (denial, shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[e042_b0022] ALEXANDER (cold, commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[e042_b0024] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (choked with tears): "Alexander..."

--- EPISODE 24 ---
[e024_b0048] ACTION: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
[e024_b0049] PRUDENCE (desperate, pleading): "My lady—"
[e024_b0051] ACTION: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
[e024_b0053] NOBLEWOMAN (furious, threatening): "Do you want the same punishment?"
[e024_b0055] PRUDENCE (terrified, murmuring): "No, my lady."
[e024_b0056] ACTION: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
[e024_b0058] SFX: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
[e024_b0060] NOBLEWOMAN (smug, gleeful): "That is where clever little servants belong."
[e024_b0062] JULIANA (cold, resolute): "Let her think I am only a maid."
[e024_b0063] ACTION: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
[e024_b0065] JULIANA (determined, defiant): "Let her believe I am ignorant."
[e024_b0066] ACTION: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
